notes_for_editor: The register is the only source for the 1936 build, the design and the 2008 registration. A hiking-map search snippet gives the mountain as 4,498 ft against the register's 2,466 ft site elevation; that page could not be read (fetch returned no text), so the conflict is unresolved and left out of the story. The register's 45-foot figure is a tower height that may not run to the cab floor, so height_m is omitted. The staffing as_of is the register entry year because the 'one of the last active' description is undated. No visit, access, fire or staffing history found; the story sends visitors to the Division of Forest Resources.
